audit.whatIsWrong: The packet carries its own defect line: the chart gave Kled 4 of 7 stages and Zaahen zero, in a lane Zaahen wins at 52.01% over 771 games.
audit.why: The already-audited mirror rebalanced to Kled 2 / Zaahen 2 / even 3 — Levels 2-3 stay Kled, Level 1 and 4-5 stay Skill, First item softens to Skill, and Level 6 and 2+ items go to Zaahen on the strength of a healing ultimate and the Determination revive against Kled's shield-and-remount.
audit.corrected: Rows 4, 5 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings and whys rewritten to match; rows 0-3 left as they are.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was called 'a wash because both have ults' with no reason and no numbers, and First item claimed Kled simply out-trades you.
audit.why: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! is 140/125/110 at 3500-4500 range and grants a shield — an engage tool, not a duel-winner. Zaahen's R is 110s at rank 1 and heals for a portion of the damage dealt, which is the stronger 1v1 ultimate. What genuinely swings First item is Kled's remount: courage refills by fighting, so the item spike matters less than his courage bar.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, phases[4..6].why and whys[4..6] rewritten around the 140s charge, the healing-vs-shielding ultimate comparison, and the courage bar as the real timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Violent Tendencies is an auto-attack reset, and this is a mutual-displacement matchup where whoever lands the displacement first owns the trade. The page also described Bear Trap as a 'root' with an 'auto-pull'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Bear Trap on a Rope hooks the target, and if shackled for a short duration it deals extra physical damage and yanks them toward Kled — a displacement, not a root, and no auto is needed. Violent Tendencies grants massive attack speed for four attacks with a heavier fourth, cast inside an attack wind-up. Zaahen carries displacement on both his Q recast knock-up and his 850-range W pull.
audit.corrected: Reset tell written into dontsFull[2].d and breakdown.cooldowns; the displacement race written into wants.you[0]; the shackle-then-yank behaviour corrected in wants.foe[0] and dosFull[0].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d carried placeholder text with no cooldowns at all.
audit.why: Bear Trap 11/10/9/8/7 at 800 range, Violent Tendencies 13/12/11/10/9, Jousting 13/12/11/10/9 with a recast that dashes back through you — the three timers a Zaahen actually plays around.
audit.corrected: All three written in with ranks.
